sections.text_helper: Section 55.1 "TIM6/TIM7/TIM18 introduction" in chapter 55 (Basic timers (TIM6/TIM7/TIM18)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2739.
sections.section_content:
The basic timers TIM6/TIM7/TIM18 consist in a 16-bit autoreload counter driven by a
programmable prescaler.
They can be used as generic timers for time-base generation.
The timers are completely independent, and do not share any resources.
